subject: general
question: According to the Census of India 2011, what is the approximate population of Sikkim?
solution:
The correct answer is **__6.11 Lakh.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the **2011** Census of India, the population of Sikkim was **6.11 Lakh.**
 
• In the total population of Sikkim males and females are** 323,070 and 287,507 **respectively.
 
• The growth rate of approximately 10.01 per cent of the population increased from 2011 in Sikkim.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Some Facts Related to Census of India 2011**__:

 
 
• ​Largest Population: Uttar Pradesh
 
• Largest Population Density: Bihar 
 
• Highest Literacy Rate: Kerala
 
• Lowest Literacy Rate: Bihar
 
• Lowest Population Density: Arunachal Pradesh.
